hypothesis.direction: Long upside escape; short downside escape.
hypothesis.entry_event: First completed accepted close outside narrow opening balance.
hypothesis.invalidation: Close back inside opening range before entry.
hypothesis.known_prior_research: Related to compression breakout but distinct because compression is first-30-minute market balance width, not indicator compression score.
hypothesis.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after escape close.
hypothesis.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Uses explicit opening-balance geometry and acceptance rather than generic volatility/compression score.
hypothesis.negative_expectation_falsifier: No WFA-positive expansion after narrow balances or controls indistinguishable.
hypothesis.participants_or_behavior: Liquidity builds inside early balance; breakout participants and hedgers transact after accepted escape.
hypothesis.persistence_rationale: Compression followed by acceptance is a market-structure transition, not an indicator combination.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return to +60 completed minutes.
hypothesis.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC; first 30-minute range; same-session bars after 09:45.
setup_state_machine: CLASSIFY narrow if opening range width <= 35 bps of open
WAIT close outside opening range by 20% of range
EMIT in escape direction next bar
hypothesis.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypothesis.structural_premise: Unusually narrow first-30-minute range stores intraday energy; a later accepted escape can continue as balance resolves.
